execution_model.stream: same OHLCV candle stream as backtest/live
order: 2. FeaturePipeline already-built series lookup OR incremental if live (design allows either; must be PIT)
3. Optionally run CRT process_candle for comparison observation only
4. Compute MarketStateVector from feature surface + interpretation config
6. Optionally record disagreement vs CRT observations
hard_invariants: shadow must not call StateMachine.try_* or mutate EngineState
shadow must not write production ACTIVE_VERSION configs

inputs.feature_surface: FeaturePipeline vectors / columns (authoritative WHAT for MSIP)
inputs.crt_observation: optional read-only snapshot of CRT state name after process_candle

outputs.run_manifest: hashes of config, schema, corpus, commit
